name: Alpenhotel Kramerwirt
beschreibung: The traditional four-star Alpenhotel Kramerwirt welcomes guests in the center of Mayrhofen in the Zillertal with hospitality dating back to 1674. The cozy rooms and suites combine Tyrolean tradition with modern comfort. On the fourth floor, the rooftop spa area “Himmelreich” invites guests to unwind with a panoramic whirlpool, sauna landscape, steam bath, and relaxation rooms overlooking the Zillertal Alps. The hotel restaurant serves regional Tyrolean cuisine alongside a rich breakfast buffet. Both in summer and winter, the hotel is an ideal base for hiking, mountain tours, and skiing in the Zillertal.
